messages:
maya: deploy-bot just flagged eu2 canary p95 jump + error spike. Auto-revert scheduled in ~3m. Do we let it run?
deploy-bot: ALERT: eu2 canary p95 410ms (+210ms) and 2.9% 5xxs over 2m. Auto-revert scheduled in 3m. Use /deploybot ack to suppress.
ryan: Let's not auto-fire. Suppress and investigate traces. If sustained >3m OR control-slice 5xx >1.5%, do a region-scoped rollback.
zoe: Quick look: traces point to new kv-serialization path causing timeouts on heavy requests; small subset of pods.
luis: Plan: suppress auto, staged rollback in eu2 to v2.9.3: 15% -> 60% -> 100%, step 5m. Prep customer note for two Dedicated tenants.
maya: Acking suppression and owner. ```/deploybot ack suppress --thread 1765433333 --by maya --reason "investigate kv-serialization" --until 2026-06-10T08:45:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: suppression acked by maya until 2026-06-10T08:45:00Z (sup-3f2e). Monitoring continues.
luis: Executing staged rollback: ```/deploybot rollout set-version --region eu2 --version v2.9.3 --traffic 15% --staged --step-duration 300s --thread 1765433333```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Initiated staged rollback to v2.9.3 in eu2. Step 1: 15% -> monitoring.
zoe: After 15% p95 down from 410ms -> 190ms, 5xxs 0.4%. KV cache miss spike but warmed quickly.
ryan: good. Proceed to 60%. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 60% --thread 1765433333```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Advanced to 60% at 2026-06-10T08:38:20Z.
luis: Metrics stable at 60%: p95 180ms, 5xx 0.2%. Proceeding to 100%. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 100% --thread 1765433333```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Rollback to v2.9.3 completed to 100% in eu2 at 2026-06-10T08:42:15Z. Telemetry: p95 175ms, 5xx 0.1%.
maya: Pin eu2 to v2.9.3 for 18h and add short rollout note in the release ticket. ```/deploybot pin-version --region eu2 --version v2.9.3 --duration 18h```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Pin applied for 18h.
zoe: Sent customer note to the two Dedicated reps; they acknowledged. Draft for #customer-notify: "We observed elevated errors in EU after a recent release; we rolled back the region to restore performance. No action required. ETA ~20m"
ryan: Follow-ups: open postmortem, add an alert for kv-serialization latencies tied to request size, and update release checklist to include a canary test with large-request profiles.
maya: I'll own the postmortem and include suppression id sup-3f2e + trace links. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
